brief:
One year after US President Donald Trump declared the war in Gaza over, according to Al-Monitor, few of the long-term promises made in connection with the ceasefire have materialized. The announcement marked what was presented as a turning point for the territory, but subsequent developments have fallen short of initial expectations.

Implementation of the agreement's terms across Gaza has stalled, with major commitments left unmet.
dek: One year after US President Donald Trump declared the war in Gaza to be over, few of the long-term promises of the ceasefire have come to fruition.
title: Gaza ceasefire promises remain largely unfulfilled year later
